classification.difficultyReason: Calculate carton capacity, apply its fill percentage, then divide by cup capacity and count full cups.

content.prompt:
A juice carton measures 8 cm by 8 cm by 15 cm. It is 80% full.
Abby uses the juice to fill some cups. Each cup holds 230 mL.
How many full cups of juice will Abby be able to fill?

questionDiagrams.alt: Rectangular juice carton with base edges 8 cm and 8 cm, and height 15 cm.

answer.worked:
$${\def\arraystretch{0.65}\begin{align*}\text{Carton volume} &= 8\times8\times15\\\text{Carton volume} &= 960\text{ cm}^3\\\text{Juice available} &= 960\times0.8\\\text{Juice available} &= 768\text{ cm}^3\\\text{Juice available} &= 768\text{ mL}\\\text{Number of cups} &= \frac{768}{230}\\\text{Number of cups} &= \frac{384}{115}\end{align*}}$$
Since $3<\dfrac{384}{115}<4$, Abby can fill 3 full cups.
